cases.requirement: Prompt includes the frozen selected approach and forbids changing it.
Both tiers share task ID, version, source commit, goal, scope, acceptance, and stop conditions.
Failure report requires last successful gate, failed step, raw error, side effects, safe resume point, and required decision.
Execution result requires changed files, tests, diff, commit, remote SHA, artifacts, limitations, unfinished items, and workspace state.
Canonical Contract freezes current/target branch, push target, PR/merge policy, and exact deletion authorization.
Chat Review alone must not create or push a remote feature branch.

Validator must support all eight feedback types: reception_ack, clarification_request, progress_checkpoint, failure_stop_report, execution_result, review_feedback, review_response, and executor_switch_checkpoint.
Validator must reject boolean-as-string, integer-as-string, array-as-string, enum mismatches, extra fields, unsafe branches, and invalid SHAs.
review_feedback.review_id must equal review_response.review_id. Executor switch task_id/task_version/source_commit must match the bundle contract.
A frozen_artifacts_only executor receives final byte-identical artifacts and no implementation discretion.
All eight artifact types reject missing, wrong-type, invalid-enum, unsafe-ref, and extra fields.
Runtime cross mode validates task, version, executor, commit, review, Git target, and switch identity.
Self-test verifies the exact Skill file set and every Manifest SHA-256.
